description: The chart illustrates the number of datasets categorized by 'Targets' (Untargeted and Targeted) across different years, from 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents the years in chronological order, while the vertical axis is labeled 'Number of datasets' with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 160, marked at intervals of 20. Each year is represented by a pair of bars: blue for 'Untargeted' and brown for 'Targeted'. The height of the bars corresponds to the number of datasets for each category. The 'Targeted' category consistently has higher values than 'Untargeted' across most years, with both categories showing an overall increase over time, particularly from 2017 onwards. Notable values include 'Targeted' reaching approximately 155 in 2021 and 'Untargeted' peaking at around 65 in the same year. The bars are grouped by year, with no specific sorting within the groups other than the categorization by 'Targets'. The chart does not visually emphasize any particular bar or year.
